Hurricane Sundeck 237
services.desc: Discover the best way to explore the stunning waters around Anna Maria Island aboard our spacious Hurricane 237 SunDeck. With plenty of comfortable seating and an open deck layout, this boat is perfect for relaxing cruises, beach hopping, and anchoring at your favorite sandbars to swim, snorkel, or soak up the sun. Powered by a reliable Yamaha 250HP engine, this boat offers a smooth, stable ride—ideal for experienced boaters looking to enjoy the beautiful Gulf Coast scenery in comfort and style. ✅ Seats up to [insert number] — perfect for family and friends ✅ Wide, open deck with wrap-around Hurricane 237 SunDeck with Yamaha 250 – Your Ultimate Anna Maria Island Adventure

services.name: Sun Tracker 22’ Tritoon
services.desc: Cruise in comfort aboard our Sylvan Tritoon, equipped with a smooth and dependable Yamaha 150HP engine. With triple pontoons for added stability and a spacious, well-designed layout, this boat is perfect for relaxing, swimming, and exploring Anna Maria Island and beyond. Designed for experienced boaters, this tritoon offers an easy, stable ride and all the features needed for a full day—or several—on the water. Whether you’re anchoring at a sandbar or spending quality time with friends and family, this boat delivers a safe and enjoyable experience. ✅ Comfortably seats around 10 people ✅ Sun Tracker Tritoon with Mercury 150 – Comfort & Stability for the Perfect Day on the Water

services.name: Sun Tracker 22’ Tritoon - Captained Tours
services.desc: Sylvan Tritoon – Captained Tours Sit back, relax, and enjoy the water aboard our Sylvan Tritoon, powered by a smooth and dependable Yamaha 150HP engine and operated by one of our licensed local captains. With its triple-pontoon design, spacious seating, and ultra-stable ride, this tritoon is the perfect platform for sightseeing, swimming, and exploring Anna Maria Island and surrounding waters. Our captained tours are designed for guests who want a stress-free, premium experience on the water. Whether you’re cruising the Intracoastal, visiting local sandbars, spotting dolphins, or enjoying a Sun Tracker 22’ Tritoon with Mercury 150 – Comfort & Stability for the Perfect Day on the Water

quotes.text: We explored the beautiful waters around Anna Maria Island and spotted dolphins! It truly made for an unforgettable birthday experience.
We had an amazing time with Compass Boat Rentals! The boat was in great shape, and the crew shared the best local spots to see.
Rented a boat for 3 days and they delivered it to our AirBnB in Cortez. Great experience and will definitely rent again.
The sunset cruise we took was just perfect—amazing views and a chill vibe! We’ll definitely be back for more adventures!
